prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

Summary of Green Party Manifesto 2024 (ideology-neutral; ≤500 words)

Health and social care
- NHS: Reduce waiting lists; rapid GP access (same-day if urgent); universal NHS dentistry; boost staff pay; invest £8bn extra in year one rising to £28bn by 2030; £20bn capital over five years; strengthen primary care (+£1.5bn/yr by 2030; £2bn capital); restore public health (+£1.5bn).
- Mental health: Evidence-based therapies within 28 days; tailored services; counsellor in every school/college.
- Cancer: Increase prevention, screening (75% stage 1–2 by 2028), and public research delivery.
- Assisted dying with safeguards; aim to end new HIV transmissions by 2030.
- Social care: Free personal care; £20bn/yr; national career structure and pay for carers; visa reforms to prevent exploitation.
- Disabled people: 5% benefit uplift; oppose PIP vouchers; improve SEND transport and workplace support.
- Children’s social care: +£3bn to councils; guaranteed counselling; extend “staying put” to 21.

Housing and planning
- Build 150,000 new social homes/year; end Right to Buy; empower rent controls; end no-fault evictions.
- Retrofit: £29bn for home insulation (to EPC B), £4bn public buildings, £9bn low‑carbon heating, £7bn heat-adaptation over five years; area-based, council-led delivery.
- New build: Passivhaus-equivalent, solar, low‑carbon heating; planning reforms, green space protection; powers to bring empty homes into use; tenancy boards; first-refusal for councils/communities to buy specified properties.

Energy and climate
- No new oil/gas licences; carbon tax rising over a decade; wind ~70% of electricity by 2030; targets by 2035: 80GW offshore wind, 53GW onshore, 100GW solar; end onshore wind barriers; expand grid, storage, interconnectors; support green hydrogen.
- Community energy ownership thresholds; £4bn/yr skills; Offshore Energy and Skills Passport.
- End imported biomass subsidies; regulate biofuels; cease new nuclear, phase out existing.

Economy, tax, and ownership
- Green investment average £40bn/yr (power, retrofit, rail, active travel, industry, water/sewage).
- Public ownership: Rail, water, Big 5 retail energy companies.
- Tax: Wealth tax (1% >£10m; 2% >£1bn); align CGT and investment income with earnings; remove NI upper limit; reform inheritance and pension relief; carbon tax £120/t rising towards £500/t in 10 years; windfall taxes; VAT shifts (cut hospitality/arts, raise on financial services/private education).
- Regional mutual banks (incl. £10bn capital); R&D +£30bn/5 years; stronger anti‑avoidance. Borrow to invest.

Work and welfare
- Minimum wage £15/h for all ages; day‑one rights; repeal anti‑union laws; 10:1 pay ratio cap; full rights for gig workers; move toward four‑day week.
- Welfare: +£40/week to Universal Credit/legacy benefits; end five‑week wait and two‑child cap; uprate pensions; +10% carers allowance; scrap bedroom tax; end sanctions; long-term UBI goal.

Nature, animals, food
- Rights of Nature Act; protect 30% land/sea by 2030; water in public ownership; Clean Air Act; +£1.5bn for DEFRA; right to roam; peatland rewetting, woodland expansion; ban destructive fishing in MPAs.
- Animal protection commission; ban blood sports; end factory farming practices; phase out animal testing.
- Farming: Nearly triple support; mixed farming; cut pesticides; expand horticulture; strengthen food security; free school meals and breakfast clubs.

Education
- Abolish tuition fees; restore grants; schools +£8bn (incl. £2bn teacher pay); £2.5bn/yr for buildings; SEND +£5bn; school counsellors/nurses; end high‑stakes testing; abolish Ofsted; bring academies under LA control; VAT on private school fees (SEN exempt); Sure Start +£1.4bn/yr; expand childcare; sixth form +£3bn; FE skills £12bn; restore EMA.

Transport
- Rail/bus subsidies to £10bn/yr; +£19bn over five years for public/active travel; rail in public ownership; local bus powers; £2.5bn/yr cycling/walking.
- Oppose new roads; road pricing; restore fuel duty escalator; EV scrappage to £5bn/yr; end new ICE sales by 2027 and road use by 2035; 20mph default in built‑up areas; shift to rail freight.
- Aviation: Frequent‑flyer levy; ban domestic flights under 3‑hour rail equivalent; tax kerosene; no airport expansion.

Democracy, rights, migration, culture, justice, foreign policy
- Fair Politics Act: PR voting, repeal voter ID, state funding, transparency; replace Lords with elected chamber; votes at 16; +£5bn/yr to local government; protect HRA/ECHR; restore legal aid; protest rights; self‑ID for trans; X passports.
- Migration: End hostile environment/NRPF/10‑year route; safe routes; let asylum seekers work; new Department of Migration; fees at cost; NHS access; remove family income thresholds; voting rights for visa holders.
- Culture/media/digital: £5bn/5 years for local arts/sport; VAT exemption for cultural events; media ownership cap 20%; implement Leveson; Digital Bill of Rights; precautionary AI regulation; protect creators’ IP.
- Justice: Presumption against custodial <2 years; expand diversion/restorative justice; end routine stop‑and‑search and facial recognition; MoJ +£11bn over parliament; tackle VAWG (misogyny hate crime; fund services); decriminalise sex work; fund youth services.
- Foreign: Support Ukraine; strengthen international law; increase aid to 1% GNI and climate finance to 1.5% by 2033 incl. Loss & Damage; pursue EU re‑entry (customs union first, Erasmus, free movement); end ISDS; sign TPNW, cancel Trident; NATO reform (no first use).
